result.title: OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
result.summary: Multimodal System One models answer visual tasks with typed decisions and native probabilities, yet no holistic evaluation compares them with general VLMs or maps either class's capability boundaries. We introduce OmniDecisionBench, a holistic benchmark of multimodal System One models. Its main evaluation assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration. A validation layer adds three single-factor diagnostics varying visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency, and target dataset. Across three System One models and two general VLMs, three regularities emerge. First, strengths depend on angle and metric: System One models lead discrete tasks overall with lower ECE15 on most perception, reading, and reasoning angles (Jev 1.14: 80.14% accuracy, 4.50% ECE15), while general VLMs lead ordinal grading and outperform Jev 1.14 among the three models tested on direct Box grounding. Second, multi-image and abstract reasoning bound every model, where confidence rather than accuracy separates them. Third, reliability shifts with the input: rendering only options nearly triples Jev 1.14's selective risk at nearly flat mean signed bias, and donor risk cutoffs often exceed target risk across unseen datasets and task families. OmniDecisionBench thus maps which model class suits each angle and where reliability ends. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/Glax147/OmniDecisionBench.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OmniDecisionBench，将 45 个数据集（192,975 条记录）按五种能力族、十二个评测角度和四种 typed 接口组织，同时评分为准确率与候选概率校准；验证层还单因子改变视觉呈现、文本证据充分性和目标数据集，用于比较 System One 模型与通用 VLM 的能力边界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 selective risk、ECE 校准与「仅渲染选项」等证据充分性诊断，可能为 LVR 中「何时 STOP/是否弃答」及视觉证据筛选的评价提供现成切面；但论文不涉及 latent 内部状态，与表示和状态更新的联系需读原文核查。
